---- MODULE W4Od7m3p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Cranes == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Containers == {"k1", "k2", "k3"}
NONE == "none"
MaxEpoch == 4

VARIABLES leader, epoch, alive, loadedBy, loadedEp, cap

vars == <<leader, epoch, alive, loadedBy, loadedEp>>

\* container k is sealed when loadedEp[k] > 0; loadedBy[k] names the crane that sealed it
TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Cranes \cup {NONE}
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ alive \in [Cranes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ loadedBy \in [Containers -> Cranes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ loadedEp \in [Containers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ cap \in 1..3

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ alive = [c \in Cranes |-> TRUE]
    /\ loadedBy = [k \in Containers |-> NONE]
    /\ loadedEp = [k \in Containers |-> 0]
    /\ cap = 2

Elect(c) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, loadedBy, loadedEp, cap>>

Fail(c) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, loadedBy, loadedEp, cap>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ ~alive[c]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, loadedBy, loadedEp, cap>>

Fire(c, k) ==
    /\ leader = c
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ loadedEp[k] = 0
    /\ Cardinality({j \in Containers : loadedEp[j] > 0}) < cap
    /\ ~ \E j \in Containers : loadedEp[j] = epoch
    /\ loadedBy' = [loadedBy EXCEPT ![k] = c]
    /\ loadedEp' = [loadedEp EXCEPT ![k] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, alive, cap>>

ChangeCap(n) ==
    /\ n \in 1..3
    /\ n # cap
    /\ cap' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, alive, loadedBy, loadedEp>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Elect(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Fail(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Recover(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, k \in Containers : Fire(c, k)
    \/ \E n \in 1..3 : ChangeCap(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Each leadership term seals at most one container: no two sealed containers
\* share the same term, so the irreversible seal happens at most once per term.
AtMostOncePerTerm ==
    \A j1, j2 \in Containers :
        (loadedEp[j1] > 0 /\ loadedEp[j2] > 0 /\ loadedEp[j1] = loadedEp[j2])
            => j1 = j2
====
nl: A container-ship crane yard runs several cranes that must agree on a single lead crane to coordinate loading. Cranes elect a lead crane; each election starts a new leadership term (epoch). The lead crane may crash, which vacates leadership and forces a fresh election (failover); a crashed crane can later recover and rejoin. Only the current lead crane may perform the irreversible seal action that loads a container into the hold, and it may seal at most one container per leadership term, and only while the hold still has spare capacity. The number of usable hold bays (the capacity) can be reconfigured at runtime. SAFETY PROPERTY: no two sealed containers were sealed in the same leadership term, so the irreversible seal happens at most once per term.

---- MODULE W4Od4m6p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Bays == {"b1", "b2"}
Cars == {"x", "y"}
NONE == "none"
MaxT == 3
Lease == 2

VARIABLES owner, expiry, clock, cap, held

vars == <<owner, expiry, clock, cap, held>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Bays -> Cars \cup {NONE}]
    /\ expiry \in [Bays -> 0..(MaxT + Lease)]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ cap \in 1..2
    /\ held \in [Cars -> SUBSET Bays]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [b \in Bays |-> NONE]
    /\ expiry = [b \in Bays |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ held = [c \in Cars |-> {}]

\* lease a free bay to a car, respecting the current active-bay capacity
Acquire(b, c) ==
    /\ owner[b] = NONE
    /\ Cardinality({j \in Bays : owner[j] # NONE}) < cap
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = c]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![b] = clock + Lease]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![c] = held[c] \cup {b}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, cap>>

\* the current lessee extends its lease before it lapses
Renew(b) ==
    /\ owner[b] # NONE
    /\ clock < expiry[b]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![b] = clock + Lease]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, clock, cap, held>>

\* an expired lease is reclaimed and the bay released
Expire(b) ==
    /\ owner[b] # NONE
    /\ clock >= expiry[b]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![owner[b]] = held[owner[b]] \ {b}]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, clock, cap>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, cap, held>>

\* the conveyor reconfigures how many bays are active
ChangeCap(n) ==
    /\ n \in 1..2
    /\ n # cap
    /\ cap' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, held>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars : Acquire(b, c)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Renew(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Expire(b)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E n \in 1..2 : ChangeCap(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Ownership records agree: a car holds exactly the bays whose lease names it,
\* so no bay is ever double-allocated behind a stale ownership record.
LeaseCoherent ==
    \A c \in Cars, b \in Bays : (b \in held[c] <=> owner[b] = c)
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line leases wash bays to cars using time-limited leases. A car acquires a free bay (subject to the number of currently active bays, the capacity), and the lease carries an expiry deadline on the wash clock. The lessee may renew its lease before it lapses. When a lease expires, the bay is reclaimed and released. The clock ticks forward. The line can reconfigure how many bays are active (the capacity) at runtime. SAFETY PROPERTY: the per-car ownership records and the per-bay lease always agree, so a car holds exactly the bays leased to it and no bay is double-allocated.

---- MODULE W4Od14m2p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Drones == {"d1", "d2"}
NONE == "none"
PerCap == 2

VARIABLES phase, vote, load, inbox, prop

vars == <<phase, vote, load, inbox, prop>>

Msgs == [drone : Drones, v : {"yes", "no"}]

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ vote \in [Drones -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ load \in [Drones -> 0..3]
    /\ inbox \in SUBSET Msgs
    /\ prop \in SUBSET Drones

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ vote = [d \in Drones |-> NONE]
    /\ load = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ prop = {}

\* coordinator proposes a surveillance batch that would add one task to each named drone
Propose(S) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ S # {}
    /\ prop' = S
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ vote' = [d \in Drones |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED load

\* a drone votes yes only if it still has spare capacity; the vote is queued (slow link)
CastVote(d) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ d \in prop
    /\ vote[d] = NONE
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.drone = d
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[drone |-> d, v |-> IF load[d] < PerCap THEN "yes" ELSE "no"]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, load, prop>>

\* a queued vote is eventually delivered to the coordinator
Deliver(m) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ vote[m.drone] = NONE
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![m.drone] = m.v]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, load, prop>>

\* commit only when every participant voted yes
Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A d \in prop : vote[d] = "yes"
    /\ load' = [d \in Drones |-> IF d \in prop THEN load[d] + 1 ELSE load[d]]
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, inbox, prop>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E d \in prop : vote[d] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, load, inbox, prop>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = {}
    /\ vote' = [d \in Drones |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED load

Next ==
    \/ \E S \in SUBSET Drones : Propose(S)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CastVote(d)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Deliver(m)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No drone is ever loaded beyond its per-drone task capacity.
CapacityHeld == \A d \in Drones : load[d] <= PerCap
====
nl: A wildfire drone surveillance swarm admits new surveillance batches through a coordinator running two-phase commit across the participating drones. The coordinator proposes a batch that would add one task to each named drone. Each drone votes, saying yes only if it still has spare capacity, otherwise no; votes travel over a slow link and are queued before delivery, so a participant may be slow to respond but never fails. Delivered votes are tallied. The coordinator commits only when every participant voted yes, applying the added load; if any participant voted no it aborts. After committing or aborting the round resets to idle. SAFETY PROPERTY: no drone is ever loaded beyond its per-drone task capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od4m1p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

StationsA == {"a1", "a2"}
StationsB == {"b1", "b2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES tokenA, tokenB, ownerA, ownerB, pending

vars == <<tokenA, tokenB, ownerA, ownerB, pending>>

NextA(x) == IF x = "a1" THEN "a2" ELSE "a1"
NextB(x) == IF x = "b1" THEN "b2" ELSE "b1"

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokenA \in StationsA
    /\ tokenB \in StationsB
    /\ ownerA \in [Slots -> StationsA \cup {NONE}]
    /\ ownerB \in [Slots -> StationsB \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pending \in SUBSET (StationsA \cup StationsB)

Init ==
    /\ tokenA = "a1"
    /\ tokenB = "b1"
    /\ ownerA = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ ownerB = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ pending = {}

\* a station signals it wants to grab a wash slot
Request(st) ==
    /\ st \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {st}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB, ownerA, ownerB>>

\* ring A passes its token to the next station
PassA ==
    /\ tokenA' = NextA(tokenA)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenB, ownerA, ownerB, pending>>

PassB ==
    /\ tokenB' = NextB(tokenB)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, ownerA, ownerB, pending>>

\* the ring-A token holder allocates a slot free across the shared pool
AllocA(s) ==
    /\ tokenA \in pending
    /\ ownerA[s] = NONE
    /\ ownerB[s] = NONE
    /\ ownerA' = [ownerA EXCEPT ![s] = tokenA]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {tokenA}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB, ownerB>>

AllocB(s) ==
    /\ tokenB \in pending
    /\ ownerB[s] = NONE
    /\ ownerA[s] = NONE
    /\ ownerB' = [ownerB EXCEPT ![s] = tokenB]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {tokenB}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB, ownerA>>

\* release a slot back to the shared pool
Release(s) ==
    \/ /\ ownerA[s] # NONE
       /\ ownerA' = [ownerA EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
       /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB, ownerB, pending>>
    \/ /\ ownerB[s] # NONE
       /\ ownerB' = [ownerB EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
       /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB, ownerA, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E st \in StationsA \cup StationsB : Request(st)
    \/ PassA
    \/ PassB
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AllocA(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AllocB(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No slot in the shared pool is allocated to both ring instances at once.
NoDoubleAlloc == \A s \in Slots : ~(ownerA[s] # NONE /\ ownerB[s] # NONE)
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line runs two independent token-ring instances that share one common pool of wash slots. Any station may first signal that it wants a slot. Each ring circulates its own token among its stations, and only the station currently holding its ring's token may allocate a slot. A token holder allocates a slot only if that slot is free across the shared pool (not held by either ring), then drops its pending request. Slots can be released back to the pool. SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot in the shared pool is ever allocated to both ring instances at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od6m8p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
Zones == {"z1", "z2"}
Floors == {"f1", "f2", "f3"}
NONE == "none"

ZoneOf(f) == IF f = "f3" THEN "z2" ELSE "z1"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, dispatched, pending

vars == <<coarse, fine, dispatched, pending>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [Zones -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ fine \in [Floors -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ dispatched \in [Floors -> 0..2]
    /\ pending \in SUBSET Controllers

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ fine = [f \in Floors |-> NONE]
    /\ dispatched = [f \in Floors |-> 0]
    /\ pending = {}

\* a controller (one of two instances sharing the floor pool) requests service
Request(c) ==
    /\ c \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, dispatched>>

\* take the coarse zone lock first
AcquireCoarse(c, z) ==
    /\ c \in pending
    /\ coarse[z] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![z] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, dispatched, pending>>

\* take the fine floor lock, only while already holding that floor's zone lock
AcquireFine(c, f) ==
    /\ coarse[ZoneOf(f)] = c
    /\ fine[f] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![f] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, dispatched, pending>>

\* the irreversible dispatch: send a car to the floor, at most once, needing the fine lock
Dispatch(c, f) ==
    /\ fine[f] = c
    /\ dispatched[f] = 0
    /\ dispatched' = [dispatched EXCEPT ![f] = 1]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(c, f) ==
    /\ fine[f] = c
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![f] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, dispatched, pending>>

ReleaseCoarse(c, z) ==
    /\ coarse[z] = c
    /\ \A f \in Floors : ZoneOf(f) = z => fine[f] # c
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![z] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, dispatched, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Request(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, z \in Zones : AcquireCoarse(c, z)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Floors : AcquireFine(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Floors : Dispatch(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Floors : ReleaseFine(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, z \in Zones : ReleaseCoarse(c, z)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The irreversible dispatch fires at most once per floor.
DispatchedOnce == \A f \in Floors : dispatched[f] <= 1
====
nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper is driven by two independent controller instances that share one common pool of floors. A controller first requests service. To act on a floor it must take locks in hierarchical order: first the coarse lock on the floor's zone, then the fine lock on the specific floor (which it may take only while already holding that floor's zone lock). Holding the fine lock, it may perform the irreversible dispatch that sends a car to the floor, which fires at most once per floor and clears the controller's pending request. A controller may release the fine floor lock, and may release the coarse zone lock only once it holds no fine lock under that zone. SAFETY PROPERTY: the irreversible dispatch fires at most once for any given floor.

---- MODULE W4Od9m5p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Feeders == {"g1", "g2"}
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES votes, shed, override, open

vars == <<votes, shed, override, open>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [Feeders -> SUBSET Nodes]
    /\ shed \in [Feeders -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ override \in [Feeders -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ open \in [Feeders -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ votes = [f \in Feeders |-> {}]
    /\ shed = [f \in Feeders |-> FALSE]
    /\ override = [f \in Feeders |-> FALSE]
    /\ open = [f \in Feeders |-> FALSE]

\* open a voting round on a feeder that has not yet been shed
OpenVote(f) ==
    /\ ~shed[f]
    /\ ~open[f]
    /\ open' = [open EXCEPT ![f] = TRUE]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![f] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, override>>

\* a grid node casts its vote to shed this feeder
Vote(n, f) ==
    /\ open[f]
    /\ n \notin votes[f]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![f] = votes[f] \cup {n}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, override, open>>

\* once a quorum has voted, perform the irreversible shed (at most once)
Commit(f) ==
    /\ open[f]
    /\ Cardinality(votes[f]) >= Quorum
    /\ ~shed[f]
    /\ shed' = [shed EXCEPT ![f] = TRUE]
    /\ open' = [open EXCEPT ![f] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, override>>

\* a privileged admin override sheds the feeder without waiting for quorum
AdminOverride(f) ==
    /\ ~shed[f]
    /\ override' = [override EXCEPT ![f] = TRUE]
    /\ shed' = [shed EXCEPT ![f] = TRUE]
    /\ open' = [open EXCEPT ![f] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

\* abandon an open round without shedding
CloseVote(f) ==
    /\ open[f]
    /\ open' = [open EXCEPT ![f] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, shed, override>>

\* when every feeder has already been shed, the shedder idles
Idle ==
    /\ \A f \in Feeders : shed[f]
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : OpenVote(f)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, f \in Feeders : Vote(n, f)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Commit(f)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : AdminOverride(f)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : CloseVote(f)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Any feeder that has been shed was authorized either by a quorum of votes
\* or by an explicit admin override.
ShedAuthorized ==
    \A f \in Feeders :
        shed[f] => (Cardinality(votes[f]) >= Quorum \/ override[f])
====
nl: A power-grid load shedder decides whether to shed each feeder by quorum vote. A voting round is opened on a feeder that has not yet been shed, clearing prior votes. Grid nodes cast votes to shed. Once a quorum of nodes has voted, the controller performs the irreversible shed of that feeder, which happens at most once. A privileged admin override may instead shed a feeder immediately without waiting for a quorum. An open round may also be abandoned without shedding. When every feeder has already been shed, the shedder simply idles. SAFETY PROPERTY: any feeder that has been shed was authorized either by a quorum of votes or by an explicit admin override.

---- MODULE W4Od11m0p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Jobs == {"j1", "j2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxVer == 3

VARIABLES phase, held, ver, rver

vars == <<phase, held, ver, rver>>

Bump(v) == IF v < MaxVer THEN v + 1 ELSE v

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [Jobs -> {"idle", "ready", "inCS"}]
    /\ held \in Jobs \cup {NONE}
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ rver \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxVer]

Init ==
    /\ phase = [j \in Jobs |-> "idle"]
    /\ held = NONE
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ rver = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]

\* optimistically read the current version of the printer register
Read(j) ==
    /\ phase[j] = "idle"
    /\ rver' = [rver EXCEPT ![j] = ver]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![j] = "ready"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, ver>>

\* compare-and-swap entry: succeed only if the version is unchanged and printer free
TryEnter(j) ==
    /\ phase[j] = "ready"
    /\ held = NONE
    /\ rver[j] = ver
    /\ held' = j
    /\ ver' = Bump(ver)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![j] = "inCS"]
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

\* the version moved under us: give up and retry from idle
Retry(j) ==
    /\ phase[j] = "ready"
    /\ rver[j] # ver
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![j] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, ver, rver>>

\* leave the critical section, freeing the printer and bumping the version
Exit(j) ==
    /\ phase[j] = "inCS"
    /\ held = j
    /\ held' = NONE
    /\ ver' = Bump(ver)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![j] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

\* privileged admin override forcibly evicts whoever holds the printer
AdminEvict ==
    /\ held # NONE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![held] = "idle"]
    /\ held' = NONE
    /\ ver' = Bump(ver)
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Read(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : TryEnter(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Retry(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Exit(j)
    \/ AdminEvict

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* At most one job is ever in the critical section (holding the printer).
MutualEx ==
    \A i, j \in Jobs : (phase[i] = "inCS" /\ phase[j] = "inCS") => i = j
====
nl: A print shop job spooler guards the single printer as a critical resource using optimistic locking with retry over a version register. A job first reads the current version. It then attempts a compare-and-swap entry, which succeeds only if the version is still unchanged and the printer is free, at which point it takes the printer, bumps the version, and enters the critical section. If the version has moved under it, the job gives up and retries from the start. A job in the critical section later exits, freeing the printer and bumping the version. A privileged admin override may forcibly evict whichever job currently holds the printer. SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one job is ever in the critical section holding the printer at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m8p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Bags == {"p1", "p2"}
Carousels == {"r1", "r2"}
Chutes == {"h1", "h2", "h3"}
NONE == "none"

CarouselOf(h) == IF h = "h3" THEN "r2" ELSE "r1"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, alloc, pending

vars == <<coarse, fine, alloc, pending>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [Carousels -> Bags \cup {NONE}]
    /\ fine \in [Chutes -> Bags \cup {NONE}]
    /\ alloc \in [Chutes -> Bags \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pending \in SUBSET Bags

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [r \in Carousels |-> NONE]
    /\ fine = [h \in Chutes |-> NONE]
    /\ alloc = [h \in Chutes |-> NONE]
    /\ pending = {}

\* a bag arrives and asks to be routed
Request(p) ==
    /\ p \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, alloc>>

\* take the coarse carousel lock first
AcquireCoarse(p, r) ==
    /\ p \in pending
    /\ coarse[r] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![r] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, alloc, pending>>

\* take the fine chute lock, only while holding that chute's carousel lock
AcquireFine(p, h) ==
    /\ coarse[CarouselOf(h)] = p
    /\ fine[h] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![h] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, alloc, pending>>

\* allocate the chute to the bag holding its fine lock, if not already allocated
Allocate(p, h) ==
    /\ fine[h] = p
    /\ coarse[CarouselOf(h)] = p
    /\ alloc[h] = NONE
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![h] = p]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

\* the bag departs, releasing its chute and its locks (coarse only if it holds no
\* other fine lock on that carousel)
ReleaseAll(p, h) ==
    /\ alloc[h] = p
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![h] = NONE]
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![h] = NONE]
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![CarouselOf(h)] =
                    IF \E g \in Chutes : g # h /\ CarouselOf(g) = CarouselOf(h) /\ fine[g] = p

Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, held, tokenA, tokenB

vars == <<owner, held, tokenA, tokenB>>

NextA(x) == IF x = "a1" THEN "a2" ELSE "a1"
NextB(x) == IF x = "b1" THEN "b2" ELSE "b1"

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> AllCranes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ held \in [AllCranes -> SUBSET Slots]
    /\ tokenA \in CranesA
    /\ tokenB \in CranesB

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ held = [c \in AllCranes |-> {}]
    /\ tokenA = "a1"
    /\ tokenB = "b1"

\* ring A circulates its exclusive-access token
PassA ==
    /\ tokenA' = NextA(tokenA)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, tokenB>>

PassB ==
    /\ tokenB' = NextB(tokenB)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, tokenA>>

\* the ring-A token holder allocates a free stow slot from the shared pool,
\* recording it on both the slot and the crane side
AllocA(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = tokenA]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![tokenA] = held[tokenA] \cup {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB>>

AllocB(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = tokenB]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![tokenB] = held[tokenB] \cup {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB>>

\* release a slot back to the shared pool, clearing both records
Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # NONE
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![owner[s]] = held[owner[s]] \ {s}]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokenA, tokenB>>

Next ==
    \/ PassA
    \/ PassB
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AllocA(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : AllocB(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The slot-side and crane-side records agree: a crane holds exactly the slots it
\* owns, so no stow slot is ever double-allocated across the shared pool.
Coherent ==
    \A c \in AllCranes, s \in Slots : (s \in held[c] <=> owner[s] = c)
====
nl: A container-ship crane yard runs two independent token-ring instances that share one common pool of stow slots. Each ring circulates its own exclusive-access token among its cranes, and only the crane currently holding its ring's token may allocate a slot. A token holder allocates a free stow slot from the shared pool, recording the allocation on both the slot side and the crane side. A slot can be released back to the shared pool, clearing both records. SAFETY PROPERTY: the slot-side and crane-side records always agree, so a crane holds exactly the slots it owns and no stow slot is ever double-allocated across the shared pool.

---- MODULE W4Od6m9p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Trips == {"t1", "t2", "t3"}
MaxE == 2

VARIABLES log, acked, epoch, pending

vars == <<log, acked, epoch, pending>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ log \in SUBSET Trips
    /\ acked \in SUBSET Trips
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxE
    /\ pending \in SUBSET Trips

Init ==
    /\ log = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ pending = {}

\* a floor trip is requested onto the shared dispatch log
Request(t) ==
    /\ t \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, acked, epoch>>

\* controller A commits a requested trip: read-modify-write that appends to the
\* shared log and acknowledges it, preserving all earlier entries
CommitA(t) ==
    /\ t \in pending
    /\ t \notin log
    /\ log' = log \cup {t}
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pending>>

\* controller B commits, sharing the same log
CommitB(t) ==
    /\ t \in pending
    /\ t \notin log
    /\ log' = log \cup {t}
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, pending>>

\* reconfiguration bumps the epoch and drops still-pending requests
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxE
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ pending' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, acked>>

\* when every trip is logged and no further reconfiguration is possible, idle
Idle ==
    /\ epoch = MaxE
    /\ \A t \in Trips : t \in log
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trips : Request(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trips : CommitA(t)
    \/ \E t \in Trips : CommitB(t)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every acknowledged trip survives in the shared dispatch log: no committed update
\* is ever lost.
NoLostUpdates == acked \subseteq log
====
nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper is run by two independent controllers that share one common dispatch log, under epoch-numbered reconfiguration. A floor trip is first requested onto the shared log. Either controller commits a requested trip as a read-modify-write that appends it to the shared log and acknowledges it, preserving all earlier entries, and each trip is committed at most once. Reconfiguration bumps the epoch and drops any still-pending requests. When every trip has been logged and no further reconfiguration is possible, the system idles. SAFETY PROPERTY: every acknowledged trip survives in the shared dispatch log, so no committed update is ever lost.
